topic: Signing Up for a Free Community ESL Class

script.title: A FREE ESL CLASS
script.scene_zh: 社區中心 · 報名桌前
script.story_hook: One form, one new class, one brave start.
script.intro_zh: 一張表格、一個新班、一個勇敢的開始。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the community center signup table. Listen for words about free English classes.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到社區中心的報名桌前。留意關於免費英文課的說法。
script.outro: That's a class signed up calmly. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一堂課就這樣從容報好了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Try saying each line after the speaker.
script.practice_intro_zh: 跟著影片，把每句大聲朗讀一次。
script.char_a_description: a round-faced woman in her late forties with shoulder-length silver-streaked hair pulled back with a blue headband, small round glasses, a green quilted vest over a plaid shirt, and a practical canvas tote bag
script.char_b_description: an elderly man in his sixties with thinning white hair combed to the side, a full grey mustache, half-moon reading glasses, a burgundy cardigan over a light blue collared shirt, and a stooped build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the table for the ESL class?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈteɪbəl fɔɹ ði ˌi ˌɛs ˈɛl ˈklæs/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這張桌子是 ESL 班報名的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, pull up a chair, how can I help?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈpʊl ʌp ə ˈtʃɛɹ haɪ kæn aɪ ˈhɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 是的，請先坐下，需要什麼幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to practice English, um, mostly speaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwɑnt tə ˈpɹæktɪs ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈmoʊstli ˈspikɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我想練習英文，嗯，主要是口說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that's exactly what this class is for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ðɪs ˈklæs ɪz fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這門課正是為了這個開設的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it really free, though? The flyer says free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈɹɪli ˈfɹi ðoʊ ðə ˈflaɪɚ sɛz ˈfɹi/
dialogue.zh: 不過，真的完全免費嗎？傳單上是寫免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Truly free, the city pays for community classes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɹuɹi ˈfɹi ðə ˈsɪti ˈpeɪz fɔɹ kəˈmjunəti ˈklæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 真的免費，市政府補貼社區課程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, because my budget is thin this year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd bɪˈkɑz maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt ɪz ˈθɪn ðɪs ˈjɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，因為我今年的預算很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No books to buy, we print everything here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈbʊks tə ˈbaɪ wi ˈprɪnt ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不用買書，講義我們全部自己印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. So, where do beginners start?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ wɛɹ du bɪˈɡɪnɚz ˈstɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那初學者要從哪裡開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every student takes one short placement test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi ˈstudənt ˈteɪks wʌn ʃɔɹt ˈpleɪsmənt ˈtɛst/
dialogue.zh: 每位學員都要先做一次短的分級測驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A test? Um, how long is this test, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɛst ʌm haʊ ˈlɔŋ ɪz ðɪs ˈtɛst ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 測驗？嗯，老實說要考多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, mostly listening and simple words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnɾi ˈmɪnəts ˈmoʊstli ˈlɪsənɪŋ ænd ˈsɪməl ˈwɝdz/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，大多是聽力和簡單詞彙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple words, I can do that, phew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪməl ˈwɝdz aɪ kæn du ðæt ˈfju/
dialogue.zh: 簡單詞彙，那我應付得來，呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The test is Thursday, right here at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtɛst ɪz ˈθɝzdeɪ ɹaɪt hɪɹ æt ˈfɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 測驗在星期四，四點就在這裡考。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday... um, I work evenings, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ ʌm aɪ wɝk ˈivnɪŋz ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 星期四…嗯，我晚上要上班，那怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We also test Saturday mornings, ten to twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlsoʊ ˈtɛst ˈsætɚdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz tɛn tə ˈtwɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 我們週六上午也考，十點到十二點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday works better, um, can I bring papers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚdeɪ wɝks ˈbɛɾɚ ʌm kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ ˈpeɪpɚz/
dialogue.zh: 週六比較合適，嗯，我可以帶文件過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your ID and a pen, we give the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔɹ aɪ di ænd ə ˈpɛn wi ˈɡɪv ðə ˈɹɛst/
dialogue.zh: 只要身分證和一支筆，其他都由我們提供。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. And what times are the actual classes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd wʌt ˈtaɪmz ɑɹ ði ˈæktʃuəl ˈklæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那正式上課是什麼時段？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a week, Mondays and Wednesdays, six to eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ə ˈwik ˈmʌndeɪz ænd ˈwɛnzdeɪz sɪks tə ˈeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一週兩次，週一和週三，六點到八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Evenings... um, that's my problem, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivnɪŋz ʌm ðæts maɪ ˈpɹɑbləm ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 又是晚上…嗯，這剛好是我的難處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A morning group meets Tuesdays and Fridays, at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ɡɹup ˈmits ˈtuzdeɪz ænd ˈfɹaɪdz æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 另外有週二和週五的上午班，九點開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine in the morning? I could do that, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪ kʊd du ðæt ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 上午九點？我其實配合得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it's mornings, Tuesdays and Fridays, nine to eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪts ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ˈtuzdeɪz ænd ˈfɹaɪdz naɪn tə ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 那就是週二和週五上午班，九點到十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only two hours each day? I love that, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu ˈaʊɚz itʃ ˈdeɪ aɪ lʌv ðæt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 一次只有兩小時？老實說我很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Adults focus better, long days burn people out.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈdʌlts ˈfoʊkəs ˈbɛɾɚ ˈlɔŋ ˈdeɪz bɝn ˈpipəl ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 大人專注時間有限，課拉太長會累垮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very true. Now, is there a level for basics?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi ˈtɹu naʊ ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈlɛvəl fɔɹ ˈbeɪsɪks/
dialogue.zh: 說得對。那最基礎的是哪一級？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, level one starts with names and numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈlɛvəl wʌn ˈstɑɹts wɪθ ˈneɪmz ænd ˈnʌmbɚz/
dialogue.zh: 有，初級班會從名字和數字教起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbers I know, um, my English has one word.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚz aɪ ˈnoʊ ʌm maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ hæz wʌn ˈwɝd/
dialogue.zh: 數字我會，嗯，我的英文只有一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one? Which word, if I may ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn wɪtʃ ˈwɝd ɪf aɪ ˈme ɑsk/
dialogue.zh: 就一個字？是哪個字，我可以問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry. I say it to everyone, all day long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi aɪ ˈseɪ ɪt tə ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ɔl ˈdeɪ ˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我整天見到人就跟人說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, level two then, you already have sentences.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈlɛvəl tu ðɛn ju ɔlˈɛdi hæv ˈsɛntənsəz/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那直接排二級班，你已經會整句了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Um, I mostly need help with phone calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ʌm aɪ ˈmoʊstli ˈnid ˈhɛlp wɪθ ˈfoʊn ˈkɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？嗯，我最需要打電話方面的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lesson six is all role-play with phones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛsən sɪks ɪz ɔl ˈɹoʊpleɪ wɪθ ˈfoʊnz/
dialogue.zh: 第六課整個都是電話情境演練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Practicing calls in class? That sounds amazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹæktɪsɪŋ ˈkɔlz ɪn ˈklæs ðæt saʊndz əˈmeɪzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 在課堂上練習打電話？聽起來太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You call a fake bank, the partner grades you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈkɔl ə ˈfeɪk ˈbæŋk ðə ˈpɑɹtnɚ ɡɹeɪdz ju/
dialogue.zh: 你撥給一家假銀行，搭檔幫你評分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, the real banks still scare me a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðə ˈɹiəl bæŋks stɪl skɛɹ mi ə ˈbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，接到真的銀行我還是會怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone feels that at first, you'll be fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn filz ðæt æt ˈfɝst jul bi ˈfaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 每個人剛開始都這樣，你會沒問題的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, one home question, my son has homework.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌn hoʊm ˈkwɛstʃən maɪ ˈsʌn hæz ˈhoʊmwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，家裡有個狀況，我的小孩有英文作業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, want help with that too? We have a tutor.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wɑnt ˈhɛlp wɪð ðæt tu ˈwi hæv ə ˈtʊɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這個也想找幫忙？我們有課後輔導。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tutor, for free, like the class?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtʊɾɚ ˈfɔɹ ˈfɹi laɪk ðə ˈklæs/
dialogue.zh: 也有免費的輔導，跟這門課一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, yes, but only two days a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹi jɛs bʌt ˈoʊnli tu ˈdeɪz ə ˈwik/
dialogue.zh: 免費，沒錯，但一週只有兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's plenty, um, he needs the math part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈplɛnɾi ʌm hi ˈnidz ðə ˈmæθ ˈpɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 很夠了，嗯，他最需要數學那部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tutors cover math first, then reading skills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʊɾɚz ˈkʌvɚ mæθ ˈfɝst ðɛn ˈɹidɪŋ skɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 輔導老師會先從數學開始，再到閱讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll love that, thank you, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil lʌv ðæt θæŋk ju ˈtɹuɹi/
dialogue.zh: 他會很開心的，真的謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, anything else for you today?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls fɔɹ ju təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那，今天還有其他要問的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just the sign-up, um, do I do it right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə ˈsaɪn ˌʌp ʌm du aɪ ˈdu ɪt ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 就剩報名了，嗯，就在這裡辦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, one page, write slowly, we check together.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp wʌn ˈpeɪdʒ ɹaɪt ˈsloʊli wi ˈtʃɛk təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，一頁資料，慢慢寫，我們一起核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use pencil? My writing is a mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz ˈpɛnsəl maɪ ˈɹaɪtɪŋ ɪz ə ˈmɛs/
dialogue.zh: 可以用鉛筆嗎？我字寫得亂七八糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pencil is perfect, mistakes are how we learn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl ɪz ˈpɝfɪkt mɪˈsteɪks ɑr ˈhaʊ wi ˈlɝn/
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆最好，犯錯就是我們學習的方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice way to look at it, okay, here goes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈweɪ tə lʊk æt ɪt oʊˈkeɪ hɪɹ ɡoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 這個說法真漂亮，好，那我開始填。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your son can join our Saturday reading club.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ ˈsʌn kæn dʒɔɪn ˈaʊɚ ˈsætɚdeɪ ˈɹidɪŋ klʌb/
dialogue.zh: 你兒子可以參加我們的週六讀書會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh yes, um, he loves books, that's great.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jɛs ʌm hi lʌvz bʊks ðæts ɡɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢太好了，嗯，他很愛看書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it's free for kids, every week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪts ˈfɹi ˈfɔɹ kɪdz ˈɛvɹi ˈwik/
dialogue.zh: 當然，小朋友完全免費，每週都開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's wonderful, he'd follow me anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈwʌndɚfəl hid ˈfɑloʊ mi ˈɛniwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，他不管到哪裡都會跟著我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Family first, that's our motto here actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməli ˈfɝst ðæts ɑɹ ˈmɑɾoʊ hɪɹ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 家人優先，說真的，這就是我們這裡的口號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, um, can I bring my cousin?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ʌm kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈkʌzən/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，嗯，我可以帶我表妹一起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's welcome, bring her Saturday at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ˈwɛlkəm ˈbrɪŋ hɜ ˈsætɚdeɪ æt ˈtɛn/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎她來，週六十點一起報到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, name, address… done, that was painless.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈneɪm əˈdɹɛs dʌn ðæt wəz ˈpeɪnləs/
dialogue.zh: 好，姓名、地址…填完了，比想像中輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Saturday, bring a pen and courage.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈsætɚdeɪ ˈbrɪŋ ə ˈpɛn ænd ˈkɝɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 週六見，記得帶一支筆，還有勇氣。

script.youtube_title: 【免費ESL英文班🏫】「家人優先」🗣️✏️🆓｜聽完自己坐進社區教室｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Free Community ESL Class
script.youtube_title_en: "Family First" — Signing Up for a Free Community ESL Class
script.youtube_description:
「家人優先」——第一次走進社區中心報名免費 ESL 班，要問清楚哪些事？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社區中心的報名桌前。

你會聽到：確認課程免費、不用買書的安心對話；分級測驗怎麼考、多久、週四晚上不行時怎麼換週六；開課時段與上午班的選擇；從名字和數字開始的初級班；電話情境演練與假銀行練習；課後輔導與小朋友的免費讀書會；最後在報名桌前慢慢填好報名表。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，語氣就是美國人聊天時的自然樣貌：um、so、phew、ha。聽完你就會用：How can I help、Is it really free、What times are the actual classes、Do I do it right here。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓耳朵先熟，嘴巴自然跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱與按小鈴鐺，下次報名從容又自信。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Family first" — what do you ask when signing up for a free community ESL class for the very first time? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at the community center signup table.

You will hear: confirming the class is truly free with no books to buy, the short placement test and swapping Thursday for Saturday, evening versus morning schedules, level one starting with names and numbers, role-play phone calls with a fake bank, free tutoring for homework, a kids reading club, and filling out the one-page form together.

Everything stays A2-level with natural speech: um, so, phew, ha. By the end you'll own lines like Is it really free, What times are the actual classes, and Do I do it right here.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
想練英文卻怕進教室就卡住：免費的 ESL 班真的有嗎？分級測驗難不難？晚上要上班怎麼選時段？小孩能不能一起來？

這一集帶大家坐在社區中心的報名桌前，從確認費用、約測驗、挑時段，一路聽到電話演練、課後輔導與現場填表，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🆓 確認費用：Is it really free, though? The flyer says free.
📝 分級測驗：Every student takes one short placement test.
🕘 時段安排：Nine in the morning? I could do that, actually.
📞 實戰演練：Lesson six is all role-play with phones.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、phew 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這張報名桌坐一回，下次自己走到社區中心，開口的第一句自然就有了。

祝你也找到那間願意等你的教室。
